description: Reviewed mappings from DPC Global Bit List 2025 evidence entries to existing canonical format records. DPC does not create canonical identities. Source-native classifications remain unchanged; mappings only declare scope and target association.

rules.review_note: DPC explicitly states that this entry covers PDF 1.1-2.0, PDF/A, PDF/X and PDF/E. The broad DPC Vulnerable assessment is therefore retained with format_group scope on matching PDF canonical records rather than treated as an exact version assessment.
Platform/service condition spanning cloud-native content; do not project automatically to individual file-format identities.
Broad audiovisual group spanning multiple containers/codecs and carrier/DRM conditions; retain as contextual evidence until narrower mappings are explicitly reviewed.
Covers messages, threads, mailboxes, servers and attachments rather than one exact format; do not project automatically to EML/MBOX/PST/MSG or other individual formats.
